items.title: 14.10.1 Hawa ki aaloodgi se jure bunyadi sehat ke khatre (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.10.1, printed pages 315-316.

items: Saans ki bimariyan: ozone, particulate matter aur nitrogen dioxide asthma ki alamaat barhate aur asthma ke daure late hain; lambi muddat ka samna purani khansi aur pneumonia jaisi saans ki infections ki taraf le ja sakta hai.
Dil aur khoon ki naliyon ki bimariyan: particulate matter aur doosre pollutants soojan, khoon ki naliyon ke nuqsan, high blood pressure aur aakhir mein stroke se dil ke daure ka khatra barhate hain.
Cancer: kuch pollutants, khaas kar particulate matter aur benzene jaise carcinogenic compounds, ka lamba samna phephron ka cancer karta hai.

Tawleedi aur nashwonuma ke asrat: hawa ki aaloodgi mardon aur auraton dono mein tawleedi sehat aur zarkhezi par bura asar dal sakti hai, aur bachchon mein qabl az waqt paidaish aur nashwonuma ke masail ho sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Masroof sarak ke saath rehne wale khandan ke liye hawa ki aaloodgi ke mumkina sehat ke khatron ka jaiza lein.
blocks.explanation: Rozana traffic ki aaloodgi unhen PM, NO2, CO, ozone aur benzene ke samne rakhti hai: bachchon ko asthma aur phephron ki ruki nashwonuma ka khatra, baron ko purani bronchitis, barha blood pressure, dil ka daura aur stroke, aur sab ko phephron ke cancer ka zindagi bhar ka zyada khatra; hamila maan ko qabl az waqt paidaish ka khatra. Khatra samne ke saalon ke saath barhta hai.

items: Khatre: saans (asthma, pneumonia), dil aur naliyan (dil ka daura, stroke), cancer (PM, benzene), tawleedi aur nashwonuma (zarkhezi, qabl az waqt paidaish).
